definitions.full: H5757. Avvi [ עַוִּי ] adjective, of a people only plural הַעַוִּים as substantive, inhabitants of II. עַוָּה 2Kin 17:31 (another עַוִּים below). עוֺז noun see עֹז below עזז . עַוִּים proper name 1. of a people ׳הָע people on southwest coast of Mediterranean before the כַּפְתֹּרִים (q. v.) came Deut 2:23 , and remaining thereafter Josh 13:3 (D 2 ), ᵐ5 Ευαιοι . 2. location ׳הָע city in Benjamin Josh 18:23 (= הָעַי ?), ᵐ5 Αιειν , Αυειμ . — See also [ עַוִּי ] above
